250 Years of US
Celebrate our nation's 250th anniversary where history happened—in our national parks!
Finding Fall Foliage
Enjoy a colorful display of fall foliage with in-person and virtual leaf peeping trips at national parks.
Park Pumpkin Project
Create gourd-geous park pumpkins this fall season using these templates or designing your own!
Batty for Bats
There are more than 50 unique species of bats found in national parks. Discover more about these fascinating flying mammals!
Campfire Safety
With National Fire Prevention Week in October, be familiar with best practices to have a fun, safe campfire experience.
Find Your Muse
Artists find inspiration for their craft in the rich nature, culture, and history preserved in national parks.
Social Media
Follow, share, and be a part of the conversation on official National Park Service social media channels.
Photos, Videos, Webcams & More
Explore the national parks through multimedia. Search for photos, videos, webcams, and audio files on any topic.
The national park community welcomes you! Together we can celebrate these special places and ensure they exist forever.
